# Vendored emoji picker

This directory contains the standalone browser runtime from Emoji Mart 5.6.0
and the native Unicode 15 dataset from `@emoji-mart/data` 1.2.1. The files are
served locally by `friend_server.py`; no CDN, IndexedDB, or internet connection
is required at runtime.

Upstream: <https://github.com/missive/emoji-mart>
